description: Historical agency identities absorbed into a survivor. Every entry is checked against the agency directory before it is applied, and an identity_duplicate whose predecessor still carries crime values is refused rather than applied.
provenance: Transcribed from the untracked reference scripts/merge-duplicate-oris.sql and re-validated against geographies.csv. The reference SQL also merges historical_staffing, which this pipeline does not build.
